subject: Request: retroactive SLA remediation & expedited RCA for BrightCart midnight checkout drops
messages:
From: Elena Marin <elena@brightcart.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightCart Platform Team <ops@brightcart.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 02:12:00 -0700
Subject: Checkout spikes to 503s during our midnight settlement job — need SLA remediation

Hi Jordan,

We saw a repeatable spike in 503 errors across our checkout flow between 00:58-01:14 PT last night during our scheduled settlement batch. This showed up in our end-to-end metrics and caused ~9% of checkout attempts to fail (approx 2.1k transactions). Our payments team had to rerun the batch and we incurred customer support overhead.

BrightCart is on the Redwood Hosted plan (us-west-2 region) with a 99.95% monthly availability SLA. We need:
- confirmation of the service-side availability window for 2028-04-03 00:58–01:14 PT
- provisional credit calculation and path to apply credit to our account
- an expedited RCA and expected delivery date (our CFO is asking for a formal note for audit)

Attached are a lightweight trace bundle and a screenshot from our monitoring. Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Thanks,
Elena Marin
Platform Reliability Lead, BrightCart
Elena Marin | brightcart.com

Attachments: brightcart_trace_2028-04-03.tar.gz; screenshot_503.png

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Marin <elena@brightcart.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 09:30:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Checkout spikes to 503s during our midnight settlement job — need SLA remediation

Elena —

Thanks for the heads-up and the artifacts. Sorry for the disruption. We saw anomalous evictions in the us-west-2 checkout pool that coincided with your window; our initial signals point to an autoscaler surge that caused transient connection churn in the serving frontends.

Immediate next steps from our side:
- Diego will pull the raw telemetry and KV-cache traces for 00:45–01:30 PT and share them by EOD.
- Laura will calculate a provisional availability window and an estimated prorated credit under your plan.
- I’ll assemble a short escalation package and schedule an expedited RCA call tomorrow morning.

Could you confirm the total transaction volume for that 16-minute window and whether you applied any client-side retries? That will help us reconcile client vs. server failures.

We’ll treat this as a high-priority escalation and aim to get a provisional remedy within 24 hours.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
[jordan_blake@redwood.ai]

From: Elena Marin <elena@brightcart.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: BrightCart Platform Team <ops@brightcart.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 11:07:45 -07:00
Subject: Re: Checkout spikes to 503s during our midnight settlement job — need SLA remediation

Jordan / Laura,

Thanks for the quick reply. We saw roughly 23,400 checkout attempts between 00:50–01:20 PT; the failure cluster is concentrated in 00:58–01:14 where ~2,100 failed with HTTP 503. We do have client-side retries on a conservative backoff; ops re-ran the settlement once at 02:30 PT.

Attached is an exported transaction sample and the lightweight traces (we redacted PII). Our legal/finance teams are asking for a written estimate of the credit so they can provision it against the invoice cycle if eligible.

We’d prefer a short preliminary RCA within 24 hours and a full RCA (with mitigations and timeline) within 5 business days.

Elena

Attachments: brightcart_transaction_sample.csv; brightcart_trace_2028-04-03.tar.gz

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Marin <elena@brightcart.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Checkout spikes to 503s during our midnight settlement job — provisional remedy and RCA schedule

Elena —

Appreciate the transaction sample and traces. We completed an initial telemetry review. Summary and next steps: 

1) Confirmed window: us-west-2 checkout pool showed elevated 5xx rate from 2028-04-03 00:56:14 PT through 2028-04-03 01:13:58 PT (16m 44s). We will produce the canonical log bundle for your records.

2) Preliminary root cause (high level): an aggressive autoscaler policy triggered scale-out while several warmup handshakes were concurrently draining KV cache handles. The combined effect produced transient connection failures in a subset of frontends handling checkout traffic. This matches the distribution in your trace bundle. Diego will include a timeline with server-side error codes in the final RCA.

3) Provisional credit: under BrightCart’s plan (monthly 99.95% SLA) the measured availability delta for the day maps to a provisional prorated credit of 3.5% of daily hosted inference charges for that billing day. Laura will prepare the formal credit note and the accounting entry; if you accept, we can apply the credit to the next invoice or issue a one-time account adjustment.

4) RCA timeline:
- Preliminary RCA (cause summary + timeline + immediate mitigations): delivered by 2028-04-04 17:00 PT.
- Full RCA (root cause, long-term mitigations, validation plan): delivered by 2028-04-10 EOD PT.

5) Compensation and follow-up: we will create a HubSpot ticket (BC-1789) and a shared Drive folder with the canonical bundle. I’ve CC’d Hannah (product reliability) to coordinate a follow-up postmortem and action items.

If that plan looks good we’ll proceed; let me know if BrightCart prefers a different remediation path (e.g., service credit escrow vs invoice adjustment).

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Account Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_telemetry_snapshot_20280403.json
